The image depicts a fish with a blue head and yellow body (resembling a Queen Angelfish or Blue Angelfish), whereas the target class 'Rock Beauty' (Holocanthus tricolor) strictly requires a black head and anterior body. This is a fundamental semantic mismatch. The Router correctly marked the mouth/teeth checkpoint as false due to lack of resolution/detail, which is appropriate given the image quality. The anatomical checkpoints (fins, tail, body shape) were correctly marked as present, as the underlying geometry matches that of an angelfish, even if the species identity is wrong.
